    //==
    // # Derived functions for the IMatrix interface
    //
    // Shape predicates, diagonal access, and the scalar folds over ElementAt (Trace,
    // FrobeniusNorm) for the IMatrix interface declared in
    // `matrices.concepts.plato`, plus the IAdditive/IScalable-derived interpolation.

    //==
    // # IMatrix
    //
    // Dense numeric matrices (IValue, IAdditive, IScalable) with RowCount,
    // ColumnCount, and ElementAt(row, column). Double and Half come from
    // CoreAlgebra (IAdditive / IScalable). Trace and FrobeniusNorm are now derivable
    // as scalar folds over ElementAt (via MapRange + Array.Reduce); see below.
    //
    // TODO(interface-gap): Transpose remains blocked — it must CONSTRUCT a matrix, and
    // IMatrix exposes no construction primitive. The MakeArray2D intrinsic builds
    // an Array2D<Number>, not a concrete IMatrix, so a generic
    // Transpose(IMatrix): IMatrix cannot be spelled here; each concrete matrix
    // type (matrices.types.plato) supplies its own, returning its own type (e.g. the
    // Matrix4x4.Transpose intrinsic).

    // True when the matrix has equal row and column counts.
    IsSquare(self: IMatrix): Boolean
        => self.RowCount == self.ColumnCount;
